theorems.name: Submission.iwl_sp_sn_weighted_fundamental_lemma
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (M W : Set (Eucl P)) (θ g : Eucl P → ℝ) (C : ℝ), IsOpen W → NullMeasurableSet M μ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ W) μ → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), |g x| ≤ C) → (∀ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → ∫ x in M, θ x * (φ x * g x) ∂μ = 0) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), x ∈ W → g x = 0
